cards.name: Coercive Recruiter
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another Pirate you control enters, gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gains haste and becomes a Pirate in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Goatnap
cards.oracle_text: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If that creature is a Goat, it also gets +3/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Mark of Mutiny
cards.oracle_text: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it and untap it. That creature gains haste until end of turn. (It can attack and {T} this turn.)

cards.name: Metallic Mastery
cards.oracle_text: Gain control of target artifact until end of turn. Untap that artifact. It gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Mountain Goat
cards.oracle_text: Mountainwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Mountain.)

cards.name: Traitorous Instinct
cards.oracle_text: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gets +2/+0 and gains haste.

rulings.comment: Goat is a creature type. You won't see this creature type printed on creatures in this set, but keep in mind that creatures with the changeling ability are Goats.
Goatnap can target any creature, even one that's untapped or one you already control.

To determine whether the target creature gets +3/+0, look at its creature types after you've gained control of it, untapped it, and given it haste. If it's not a Goat at this time, it won't get +3/+0, even if it becomes a Goat later in the turn. If it is a Goat, it gets +3/+0, even if it stops being a Goat later in the turn.
Goat is a creature type. Keep in mind that creatures with the changeling ability are Goats. (Whether they're "goated" or not is too subjective for this ruling to address.)
Goatnap can target any creature, even one that's untapped or one you already control.

To determine whether the target creature gets +3/+0, look at its creature types after you've gained control of it, untapped it, and given it haste. If it's not a Goat at this time, it won't get +3/+0, even if it becomes a Goat later in the turn. If it is a Goat, it gets +3/+0, even if it stops being a Goat later in the turn.
Mark of Mutiny can target any creature, even one that you already control or that is already untapped.
The +1/+1 counter remains on the creature after the control-changing effect ends.
You may target a creature you already control. You may target a creature that’s already untapped.
Coercive Recruiter's ability can target any creature, even one that's untapped or one you already control. It can even target itself or the creature that caused the ability to trigger.
Gaining control of a creature doesn't cause you to gain control of any Auras or Equipment attached to it.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
